title: 13 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Shortness Of Breath
intro: Herbal essential oils for Shortness of Breath are highly concentrated plant extracts used to alleviate respiratory discomfort and promote breathing ease. These oils are beneficial in treating shortness of breath due to their expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to open airways, reduce congestion, and combat oxidative stress. Examples of herbal essential oils that can be used to treat shortness of breath include Peppermint oil, which cools and decongests the airways; Eucalyptus oil, which has natural anti-inflammatory properties; Ginger oil, which helps to relax the body and reduce respiratory spasms; Thyme oil, which fights off respiratory infections; Frankincense oil, which reduces inflammation and promotes relaxation; and Rosemary oil, which improves circulation and reduces respiratory congestion. By incorporating these oils into aromatherapy or using them in a diffuser, individuals can experience relief from shortness of breath and enjoy improved respiratory health.

preparations.preparation_desc: Eucalyptus globulus essential oils have been traditionally used to treat shortness of breath, a common symptom of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The properties of this herbal preparation, including its decongestant, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, help to relieve congestion and promote easy breathing. The bioactive constituents of eucalyptus globulus essential oils, including eucalyptol, limonene, and alpha-pinene, have been shown to help open up airways and reduce inflammation, making it easier to breathe. The benefits of using eucalyptus globulus essential oils to treat shortness of breath include improved lung function, reduced coughing, and enhanced overall respiratory health.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "African journal of traditional, complementary, and alternative medicines : AJTCAM", Eucalyptus globulus essential oils were identified as one of the important species used by Togolese traditional healers to treat symptoms associated with asthma, including shortness of breath.

preparations.preparation_desc: Rosmarinus officinalis essential oils, derived from the leaves of the rosemary plant, have been traditionally used to alleviate symptoms of shortness of breath due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Rosmarinus officinalis essential oils, including camphor, borneol, and bornyl acetate, contribute to its expectorant properties, while also providing anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The benefits of using Rosmarinus officinalis essential oils to treat shortness of breath include improved lung function, reduced congestion, and enhanced overall respiratory health.

Regular use of Thymus vulgaris essential oils may provide relief from shortness of breath, making it easier for individuals to engage in physical activities and improve their overall quality of life.

intro_study: According to "Pharmaceutical biology", essential oils for shortness of breath, specifically Agastache mexicana ssp. mexicana (toronjil morado), have been found to have a relaxant effect on guinea-pig trachea smooth muscle, which may be attributed to the blockade of calcium influx, likely due to the presence of estragole and d-limonene in the essential oil.
